**VERDICT:** Severe existential risk (9/10). Two compounding threats: routine YT DOM A/B tests breaking acquisition for days during Chrome Web Store (CWS) review, + permanent CWS/YT ToS takedown killing 80% of growth overnight. Treat extension as temporary arbitrage, engineer around CWS bottlenecks immediately.

**1. TECH MITIGATION (Days 1–7)**
* **Remote-config selectors:** Manifest V3 (MV3) bans remote *code*, allows remote *data*. Fetch CSS/XPath selectors & DOM anchor rules via remote JSON on load, cache locally. Cuts DOM-break recovery from days (CWS review) to mins.
* **Fallback UI (`chrome.sidePanel`):** Never fail silently. If DOM injection fails, auto-trigger Chrome Side Panel or extension popup so signup + core workflow survive w/o YT page modification.
* **Resilient targeting:** Ditch obfuscated/minified classes. Target `<ytd-*>` custom element tags, ARIA roles/labels, URL state, or official YT IFrame/Data APIs where possible (mind quota limits).
* **Canary testing:** Run headless browser tests (Playwright) vs live YT every 2 hrs across multiple Google accounts/IPs to catch YT's 1–5% A/B DOM rollouts before global deploy. Alert on failure.

**2. PRODUCT & COMPLIANCE (Days 8–30)**
* **Immediate off-platform capture:** Trigger dedicated onboarding tab on `chrome.runtime.onInstalled` to capture email/auth *before* user touches YT. If extension dies, you keep the user.
* **Speed up CWS reviews:** Request narrowest permissions (`*://*.youtube.com/*`, never `<all_urls>`). Broader permissions trigger manual CWS reviews, turning 24-hr hotfixes into 1–2 wk outages.
* **Audit YT ToS:** Zero interference w/ YT ads, video downloading, or background play, & no unauthorized bulk scraping. Google aggressively bans extensions touching YT monetization.

**3. STRATEGY (Days 30–90+)**
* **Decouple retention from acquisition:** Push activated users to standalone web/desktop/mobile app so LTV survives even if CWS pulls extension.
* **Cap channel concentration:** Funnel current extension cash flow/users into owned channels (SEO, referrals, paid, creator sponsorships). Target <30% new-user reliance w/in 6–12 mos.
